question: Can an external JSON receipt bind a declared rational space, ordered basis, operator and word to a receiver-selected context while recomputing every reported residual?
level: external research validator, not Rust semantic authority
objects: Q^d for d=2 or 3; canonical rational strings; invertible rational operators; declared ordered bases
receiver_input: Expected SHA-256 context fingerprint supplied separately from the receipt, from an independently selected local context; not authentication or a trusted identity
procedure: Strict JSON and scalar bounds, complete schema, external context binding, matrix invertibility, basis independence, exact ordered affine replay, independently evaluated polynomial residual, evidence equality, then coverage judgment
controls: changed operator bound to old context
changed basis bound to old context
changed dimension bound to old context
acceptance: All declared outcomes are reproduced, including a fresh basis; partial evidence remains UnknownCoverage unless an observed nonzero residual already refutes the universal claim
protected: No stable API or native identity
No Rust certificate, free, Seal, M6 filler or geometry admission
Context fingerprints do not identify histories or authenticate authors
No restored halted search or universal grammar claim
exit: Stop after the fixed suite or on failure/resource exhaustion; at most one implementation correction replay; retain exact inputs, outputs and measured costs
